current_wrist_control.feedback: fixed guitar-local wrist origin and xyzw orientation; arm12 only; no pad error
current_wrist_control.correction_algorithm: raw dq=DLS(qposJ,error); candidate=actual_arm_q+dq; proposal=base+stored_correction; delta=clip(candidate-proposal,+/-correction_step_rad); existing request rate/bounds; correction=request-base
current_wrist_control.requested_delta_scope: candidate minus proposal clipped to correction_step_rad before combined requested-target rate/bound clipping; inactive reset rows zero
current_wrist_control.candidate_arm_scope: actual arm q plus raw qpos DLS dq before correction-step/request rate/bound clipping; inactive reset rows use valid proposal=base+stored_correction
current_wrist_control.target_bounds: actual controller action bounds; accumulated correction clamped without windup
current_wrist_control.requested_target_rate: existing per-axis controller rate, arm3rad/s; native alpha0.2 remains
current_wrist_control.jacobian_coordinates: q-position differential: wrist-origin native J times ownjoint qpos-differential-to-native-velocity transform
current_wrist_control.jacobian_basis: S T = Rparent SO3left(Aq) A; S is ownbody native angular block; FK parent exp(Aq) bind has right-side bind
current_wrist_control.reset: reset only affected teacher rows; no physics step; reset rows excluded from basis solve and zeroed before DLS solve; inactive actual q replaced by proposal and delta zero; feedforward preserved
current_wrist_control.limitation: finite feedback target request; actual pose or3s arrival not guaranteed

candidate_trace_scope: actual arm q plus raw qpos DLS dq before correction-step/request rate/bound clipping; inactive reset rows use valid proposal=base+stored_correction
requested_delta_scope: candidate minus proposal clipped to correction_step_rad before combined requested-target rate/bound clipping; inactive reset rows zero
source_test_scope: upstream current-source tests/review are separate; this script audits precheck readers/settings/model/inputs
scope: preparation only; no native outcome or learned performance
